Meta.title: Vinicius Belchior — Software Engineer
Meta.description: Portfolio of Vinicius Belchior — Software Engineer & Data Analyst. Python, Django, React, Next.js, TypeScript.

Hero.descPart2: I build scalable platforms, smart automations and products with real business impact in high-complexity environments.

About.p1: I'm a Full Stack developer with solid experience in scalable projects, process automation and data analysis applied to high-complexity businesses. I work with Python (Django, Pandas, NumPy) on the backend, JavaScript/TypeScript with React.js/Next.js on the frontend, and R for statistical modeling.
About.p2: I've worked on portfolios with monthly revenue above R$ 1M, built analytical reports that reduced mean time to resolution, and based on data analysis, helped teams hit the best historical performance marks at Mapfre, Volkswagen and Honda accounts.
About.p3: Focus on quality, scalability and direct business impact. With RESTful APIs, WebSockets, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Azure infrastructure with CI/CD.

Achievements.intro: Engineering, math and teamwork that preceded my life in software — and still shape how I think about critical systems today.
Achievements.projectMeta: 17 years old · high school · ETEC Bauru
Achievements.projectDescription: As the capstone project of my technical degree in Systems Development, I built, with 4 friends, a rocket that competed at LASC (Latin American Space Challenge), the largest rocketry competition in Latin America, in the 500-meter category. We were the only high-school team competing in that category.
Achievements.roleDescription: Responsible for aerodynamic drag calculations, descent trajectory prediction and parachute sizing, ensuring the rocket completed the round trip safely and on time, accounting for wind disturbances and thrust loss.
Achievements.quote: I learned early that critical projects don't depend on a single person — they depend on math, on safety margins and on a team that trusts every gear of the system.
